channel.title: The Business Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Business Standard (tbsnews.net)

item.title: Proteas thrash Afghans to grab first win
item.description: It was not the most convincing display from the Proteas but in the end a good bowling performance led by Imran Tahir meant that victory was a forgone conclusion

item.title: Rohit ton guides India to seventh straight WC win over Pakistan
item.description: It was always going to tough for Pakistan given their World Cup record against India which read six losses and zero wins and this loss further added to their woes

item.title: Sarfaraz blames another batting collapse for loss
item.description: Pakistan, who at one point were in the chase at 117/1, lost Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez and Shoaib Malik for 12 runs within three overs as Kuldeep Yadav and Hardik Pandya caused havoc

item.title: Ruman becomes first Bangladeshi Archer to win World Cup medal
item.description: Ruman ended his campaign on a high when he outplayed Mauro Nespoli of Italy by 7-1 set points in the bronze medal deciding match of men’s recurve event in the Netherlands

item.title: Shakib believes batting at no.3 best for him
item.description: The left-handed batsman scored a brilliant 124-run innings off just 99 deliveries and helped Bangladesh chase down a challenging 322 target with ease against the Windies at Taunton on Monday.

item.title: Afghans search for maiden win but face mighty England
item.description: The two teams will do battle at Manchester, Tuesday, on what seems to be an uneven contest on paper.

item.title: South Africa and Pakistan battle for survival
item.description: At least Pakistan had a big win against the more fancied hosts England, but apart from a win against the unimpressive Afghanistan, it has been all doom and gloom for the Proteas.

item.title: Jesus takes centre stage as Brazil win Copa America
item.description: Peru however, pushed forward in the second half and were thrown a lifeline with 20 minutes remaining when Jesus was sent off.

item.title: Mithun, Mushfiqur fifties guide Tigers to win in warm-up
item.description: It was a solid batting display by the Tigers as they chased down a challenging 282 runs with 11 deliveries to spare.

item.title: Commodities continue to be dearer
item.description: The prices of essential consumer products such as oil, flour, sugar and pulses have also gone up by Tk5-10 per kilogram in the last week
